name: openstation-neighborhoods
description: The hosted OpenStation community client for Matrix rooms carried by Beeper Desktop.
author: OpenStation Contributors

scripts.deploy:preview: npm run check && spacefast publish ./dist --team openstation --space openstation-chat --spa true --target preview --wait --source-type git
scripts.release:promote: spacefast rollback "${SPACEFAST_VERSION:?Set SPACEFAST_VERSION to an approved preview version}" --team openstation --space openstation-chat --channel live --wait --yes
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
